## Description

Deploy production for the launch country from a tag, verify private networking, backups, alerts and the 12 data-protection layers, then create one production tenant per partner clinic with owner accounts (MFA) and feature flags for R1 only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Production passes the 12-layer checklist (docs/04-security-compliance) with evidence.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each partner clinic has its own tenant; owners signed in with MFA and accepted ToS/DPA.
- [ ] **AC3.** Only R1 features are enabled by flags; clinical modules are not reachable.
- [ ] **AC4.** Synthetic data is never present in production (check).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
